reviewScope: 7 distinct original G1 U02 student task statement PDF files within a single unreleased 500-lesson batch
observationMethod: Page-structured text extracted from original 2021 Student Task Statement PDFs through authorized device Our-CS on 2026-10-16; no image-by-image human review or authoritative publisher graphic identity comparison performed
sourceRights: Original IM 2021 publisher content used for comparison; this file contains authored short paraphrases only, no original publisher PDF images or student sheets.
nonCertificationNotice: Text inspection does NOT establish graphic fidelity, pedagogical equivalence, real student activities, survey participation, teacher academic approval, or permission for B001 publication.

lessons.observedTaskDescription: Compare addition result unknown with change unknown using equivalent stories; students draw and write equations, then solve book stories including take-away.
blockingFindings: Student-authored drawing and matching equation are requested by the source but the numeric answer alone does not verify them.
Page 1 equations and other embedded graphics not visually signed off.

lessons.observedTaskDescription: Math picture warm-up; center choice includes Sort and Display, Math Stories and Find the Pair.
blockingFindings: The generated 1-or-2 equation-choice problem does not collect a student-authored picture story.
Center choice and actual participation in the three alternative centers are not implemented/verified.
Original math picture visuals not independently inspected.

lessons.observedTaskDescription: Put together a pet total with no join/leave action; compare two equations for the same groups; further centers available.
blockingFindings: The numeric total does not verify both student equations, reasoning about commutativity, or student drawings.
Source equation images are not visually reviewed; classroom center activities untested.

lessons.observedTaskDescription: Two-color counters are split several ways; pupils write an equation for each combination and may enumerate all possible pairs.
blockingFindings: Numeric 1-or-2 recognition of a single decomposition is materially narrower than producing several partitions/equations; require a constructed-response/interactive partition task.
Embedded counters and original arrangements still need human visual comparison.
Student physical Shake and Spill participation not verified.

lessons.observedTaskDescription: Shake and Spill with a cup hiding some counters; solve missing addend using known whole and visible counters; source contains pictorial conditions.
blockingFindings: The generated text supplies visible count; fidelity of source graphical cup/counters contexts still needs visual review.
Physical manipulative model and students' equations/drawings not observed.

lessons.observedTaskDescription: Han's reptile stories compare total unknown, one part unknown, and both parts unknown; a gallery walk compares drawings and equations.
blockingFindings: Numeric answers do not evaluate student-generated decompositions, comparative explanations, or gallery-walk participation.
Original source contexts and student representations remain subject to visual/teacher review.

lessons.observedTaskDescription: Mental subtraction warm-up; center choice includes Math Stories, Shake and Spill, and Capture Squares.
blockingFindings: Summing two dice without actually representing board/line legality or capturing a square does not validate the gameplay.
Alternative source center choices and real pupil group turns are not represented/tested.
